summary: Iteration 9: Verified the UI-only refactor of the manual USSD checkout in PaymentMethodPicker.js. All 7 requested checks pass end-to-end: (1) ussd-code and copy-ussd-code testids no longer exist in DOM, ussd-panel still renders; (2) MVola shows 'Selneker Dino' + 0383905692, Orange shows 'Selneker Dino' + 0377519833; (3) compact copy-merchant button copies ONLY the raw phone number (verified via navigator.clipboard.readText for both providers); (4) ussd-button label = 'Payer via USSD · 3 000 Ar' with dynamic total and correct tel: URIs for both MVola (#111*1*2*0383905692*3000*1*0#) and Orange (#144*1*1*0377519833*0377519833*3000*1#); (5) submitting manual order without reference is blocked (stays on /commande), with reference creates order that lands in status 'awaiting_verification' (verified via GET /api/orders/track); (6) summary shows PUBG ID + pseudo block, total matches cart, submit button label = 'Envoyer la commande'; (7) at 390x844 no horizontal overflow. Backend GET /api/payments/config returns papi_auto=false, both providers named 'Selneker Dino' with correct numbers.
